title: RM2k3 Input Configurator - reassign keyboard and gamepad functions

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
Hey folks,
I created this online tool to patch your RPG_RT.exe for custom keyboard and gamepad assignments. This also makes it possible to use 6 buttons on the gamepad (A, B, X, Y, L, R) for different functions and not just 3.
Here you go:
https://rpg-maker.cherrytree.at/rpg2003-input-configurator/
~Cherry

posts.author: Felix Trapper
posts.body: Thank you Cherry! Gamepad/input limitations was honestly one of the biggest roadblocks for me using 2k3 more seriously. This may get me going again!

posts.author: bandkanon
posts.body: This is a godsend, thank you.

posts.author: ElionFR
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I'am French, sorry if i make mistakes
I've known RPG Maker 2003 for a very long time (since I was 15, I'm 40 now). After a long period of inactivity, I recently discovered the official version of the software, as well as the Maniacs patch which makes the software even more exceptional.
So I got back into it and am gradually discovering RM2k3's new features (really cool!).
However, I always found it a shame that you couldn't modify the software's native keys. This would be really helpful in improving the player's gaming comfort.
And that's when I came across your post, Cherry!
Unfortunately, the patch isn't compatible with the current version of Maniacs  : I'm using version 241028.
I wanted to know if you plan to update your patch to make it compatible ?
Thank you in advance for your feedback!

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body: Hi, the newer versions of Maniacs are complete rewrites of the engines, they work so differently that I can't support them.

posts.author: ElionFR
posts.body:
Hi Cherry, thank you for responding to me so quickly
Okay, I understand.
It's a shame because I think this is a feature RM2k3 is sorely missing !
I hope a future Maniacs update will include it.
Or maybe I'll downgrade to an earlier version of Maniacs so I can use your patch, I'll think about it.
Thank you again for your response, and even more so for everything you have contributed to the global RM2k3 community. I have been following your work for years and admire everything you do.
It is thanks to people like you that the passion to create continues !
